description: This Java class defines a request object for retrieving cluster information from a Zigbee device. It extends a DeviceRequest class, encapsulating logic to execute the request on a MockZigbeeDevice and send a response with cluster details.

classes.name: GetClustersInfoRequest
classes.description: A request class to retrieve cluster information (input/output clusters and device details) from a specific endpoint of a Zigbee device.

methods.name: GetClustersInfoRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request with request ID, device EUI64, and endpoint ID.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Executes the request on a provided MockZigbeeDevice, retrieves endpoint info, and sends back a response with cluster and device details.
